caption: The API is stateless: your application keeps the conversation history and sends all of it with every request, the model generates the reply one token at a time, and the reply is appended to the history for the next turn.
alt: The application holds the message history: a system prompt and the user and assistant turns so far. On each request it sends the whole history to the model. The model generates the reply token by token until an end token or the limit. The reply is appended to the history, which grows with every turn, and nothing is stored on the model's side.
